scenario: Blank lines emit no tokens per LLEX.5.2 — a rule with multiple patterns separated by blank lines compiles cleanly, as if the blank lines were absent. Tests that blank lines inside a rule body don't produce NEWLINE/INDENT/DEDENT and don't disrupt the parser.
rules_ds:
schema A scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema B scope logical:
    w: Int key

rule r:
    A a where a.v > 0

    B b where b.w > 0

->
    log info "ok"
